name: Fill/Dispense Notification
sourceRefs: usnistgov/tcamt-2 tcamt-lite-controller/SCRIPT_XML_10_6.xsd (NIST-hosted, real official-provenance NCPDP SCRIPT XSD, <xs:element name="RxFill"> ~line 469) -- a pharmacy-to-prescriber notification that a prescription was filled, not filled, or partially filled. Sourced from SCRIPT v10.6 (an OLDER wire format than this engine's own v2017071 target) since no free v2017071 schema/sample containing RxFill exists -- the same class of cross-version structural reference already used for the lifecycle transactions via cosyte/ncpdp, just from an XSD instead of a TypeScript parser. FillStatus (RES) is modeled as a 3-way choice of sibling elements (Filled/NotFilled/PartialFill), reusing the already-built OutcomeReason group's ReasonCode/ReferenceNumber/DenialReason/Note shape (FillStatusType's own NoteType/DeniedFillType sub-shapes are a near-exact match: ReferenceNumber+Note for Filled/PartialFill, ReferenceNumber+Note+FillReasonCode for NotFilled) rather than authoring a new, structurally-identical group.

Pharmacy/Prescriber/Patient are modeled by REUSING this engine's own existing NewRx-era groups (Pharmacy/Prescriber/Patient) rather than the XSD's own MandatoryAddressPharmacyType/PrescriberRxFillType (a flatter, RxFill-specific shape with Identification/ClinicName/PrescriberAgent fields this engine doesn't otherwise model) -- a deliberate, named simplification trading some RxFill-specific detail for structural consistency with every other already-built transaction type, matching this project's own 'core fields, not exhaustive' precedent.
Request (a short pass-through echo of the original request, minOccurs=0) is NOT modeled -- no real sample or v2017071-confirmed shape exists for it; a named, deferred gap, not fabricated.
Supervisor and Facility (both minOccurs=0 in the source XSD) are NOT modeled this pass -- a named, deferred simplification.
